errors.evidence: The stated range for the Cardio fine-tuned model (the light orange bar) is incorrect. The actual values for this bar across the different specialty groups range from approximately -26 (in the Cardio group) to -23 (in the Infect group). The reported range of -23.3 to -22.8 is completely different and does not reflect the data in the chart.
